status: test IPA; await owner iPad acceptance before the 1.0.0 release
changes: Reserve the terminal status area for the invisible window resize corner; give SwiftTerm an explicit viewport and propagate changed rows/columns to the PTY.
Separate sparse memfd logical length (up to 2 GiB) from the 128 MiB retained working-set budget; support KEEP_SIZE reservation.
Use xdg_toplevel parent and min/max size hints to fit transient dialogs and keep fixed-size dialogs fixed.
Add a read-only File Provider with a Trames/Alpine hierarchy, multi-root catalog, production manifest parser and chunked regular-file export.
Migrate an existing private environment only before VM startup; preserve private storage when no shared App Group is available or migration fails.
Stage complete Linux imports then atomically replace same-name regular files when the user enables replacement.

notes: The first generated extension plist lost NSExtension; the build now uses the explicit plist and checks its metadata before tests and packaging.
The production snapshot fixture also contains the automatically created /dev directory. Its missing test expectation was corrected; this failed check alone is rerun.
The first original-foot prepare hit a Debug interpreter timeout in font-cache triggers. Its Release rerun passed; successful native and GTK steps were not repeated.

The package finalizer runs after normal simulator/device linking too, avoiding reliance on unsupported arbitrary generated INFOPLIST_KEY settings. Repackaging checks bound source hashes and successful build/test steps before downloading original compiled products.
Documentation, validation record and restoration of the build-ios.sh executable mode are committed afterward with [skip ci]; no extra app build is triggered.
